title: Lemon Chive Aoli (aioli)
preamble:
Although perfect for the grilled skewers, this multipurpose dip is also delicious with crunchy fresh vegetable sticks. Try with a raclette recipe.
Ingredients:-
1
cup (250 mL) light mayonnaise
2
tbsp (30 mL) finely chopped fresh chives or green onions
1
tbsp (15 mL) grated lemon rind
2
tsp (10 mL) lemon juice
2
tsp (10 mL) grainy mustard
1
clove garlic, minced
1/4
tsp (1 mL) salt
1/4
tsp (1 mL) pepper
